main.summary: Persists retryable deletion jobs in the DataControl PostgreSQL database, keyed by catalog, item, and item instance token.

field.name: contexts
field.summary: Factory used to create DataControl database contexts.

constructor.name: PostgresDataControlDeletionJobStore
constructor.param: Factory used to create DataControl database contexts.

method.name: EnsureDeletionJobAsync
method.summary: Creates a deletion job if absent and returns the job for the exact item instance.
method.param: Token identifying the current item instance.
method.returns: The existing or newly created deletion job state.

method.name: LoadDeletionJobAsync
method.summary: Loads the deletion job for the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: The matching job state, or when none exists.

method.name: LoadDueDeletionJobsAsync
method.summary: Loads a bounded batch of jobs whose retry time is due.
method.param: Current UTC time used to determine whether a job is due.
Maximum number of jobs to return; must be positive.
method.returns: Due deletion jobs ordered by retry time and last update.

method.name: AdvanceDeletionAsync
method.summary: Advances one job stage only when its current stage matches the expected stage.
method.param: Next job stage, which must immediately follow the expected stage.
method.returns: when exactly one job was advanced.

method.name: RecordDeletionFailureAsync
method.summary: Records a failed attempt and schedules the job for a later retry.
method.param: UTC time when another attempt may run.
method.returns: when exactly one job was updated.

method.name: DeleteDeletionJobAsync
method.summary: Deletes the job for the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: when exactly one job was deleted.

method.name: ValidateIdentity
method.summary: Validates that the catalog, item identifier, and item instance token are present.

method.name: ToState
method.summary: Converts a PostgreSQL deletion-job row into provider-neutral job state.
